payload.text:
**Now:**
1. Open the app link.
2. Go to **Settings** -> **Admin Portal**.
3. You will see all 5 chapters listed. 
4. Click **EDIT** on any of them.
5. You can now see and change the **Image URL** directly! 

(Pro Tip: You can find beautiful spiritual images on Unsplash.com, right-click any photo, select "Copy Image Address", and paste it into that box in the Admin Studio!)
Images aren't loading for other users

**Analyzing Image Loading Issue**

I'm now investigating the image loading problem for other users. I've focused on `constants.tsx`, where initial data like `INITIAL_DEVOTIONALS` and `INITIAL_SUNDAY_SCHOOL` are stored. I am looking into how this interacts with the `storageService.ts`, particularly the `getDevotionals` function, to identify potential causes.


**Pinpointing Root Cause**

Okay, I think I've got it. It looks like the issue stems from how different users interact with the app. An admin's local storage is updated, but other users aren't seeing the changes because they load the default data. I'm checking the current `constants.tsx` to confirm if it has default Unsplash URLs, which it does. My initial thought about the big JSON block in the previous prompt being integrated into `constants.tsx` seems likely. The previous prompt did include a JSON payload with `imageUrl` properties, so I'll correlate this to the Unsplash and `picsum.photos` links in the source code.


**Clarifying Global vs. Local**

I've zeroed in on the critical distinction between local and global data updates. My analysis suggests the problem isn't just about image URLs themselves; it's about *where* those URLs are stored and how they are accessed by different users. The `AdminPanel.tsx` code makes it explicit: local storage is updated, but this does not affect default data in the `constants.tsx`. I believe the core issue lies in the expectation that changes made via the admin panel are immediately reflected globally, which isn't how it's implemented. The images provided via `picsum.photos` should be considered an alternative URL scheme for the user's specific data, instead of default images.


**Reconciling Data Sources**

My focus is now on the discrepancies between the user's data and the current application setup. I've re-examined the image URLs associated with specific lesson IDs, comparing them to what's in the current `constants.tsx`. It seems the user's expectation is for *their* specific URLs to be displayed, rather than the default Unsplash images. I'm considering whether we should use the `picsum.photos` scheme they provided. The key question is whether the app should use the user's initial data as default, or whether it should be treated as dynamic overrides for image URLs.


**Identifying Data Migration Issue**

I've homed in on a critical data migration problem. My focus is now on `storageService.ts` and how it handles initial data loading and updating. It seems that users with old, potentially empty, or incomplete data in `localStorage` aren't getting updated with the current `INITIAL_DEVOTIONALS`. My thought is to add a version check or a method to merge and force an update of the `localStorage` data when there are changes to the master data.


**Confirming Data Consistency**

I am now focusing on ensuring data consistency and implementing appropriate fallback mechanisms. I'm verifying that the `INITIAL_DEVOTIONALS` in `constants.tsx` accurately reflects the user-provided data, including the `picsum` URLs for their specific lessons, as they provided these explicitly. I'm cross-referencing this with the JSON block to ensure the image URLs align, and to ensure we do not have missing images. I must ensure the correct URLs are used.


**Implementing Data Updates**

I'm now fully committed to ensuring that the application reflects the latest data for all users. I will update `constants.tsx` with user-provided `picsum.photos` image URLs to ensure a consistent experience. To address data staleness, I'm integrating a `VERSION` constant. My strategy is to check the version of the data in `localStorage` against the application version, and clear the local storage if it's outdated, thereby forcing a refresh from the master content. I am confident this resolves the "images aren't loading" issue. I will also incorporate a "Sync with Master" option in the settings as a manual override to help users update their data if the automatic update fails.

I have identified why other users aren't seeing the images. In a web app like this, your browser saves a copy of the "Spirit Meal" list in its own **Local Storage**. 

If a user visited your app yesterday before you added the images, their browser is still showing the "old" list it saved. I have now added a **Data Versioning System**. This forces every user's browser to check for the latest "Master Version" of your book. If the master version is newer (like it is now with the images), it will automatically update their phone or computer to match yours!

I also updated the master list to use the **exact** image links you provided in your text.

      "content": "SUNDAY SCHOOL LESSON OF TLCGMI 

WEEK 47 – WEEK 48

Eat your bread; sow your seed. You do not sow your bread; and you do not eat your seed. Doing so is doable but is a dangerous mismatch. 

The Isaiah verse in the study text opens our eyes to see that the earth produces seed and bread. The farmer [sewer] picks the seed and plants it, while the consumer [eater] picks the bread and eats it.

THE POWER OF SEED
Seeds have productive mandate. A seed is endowed to produce multiple other seeds endlessly. All seeds die to produce new life. 

THE BELIEVER’S SEED
Do not eat your seed. Do not waste your seed. There is a seed in your hand. See it as seed and not bread to be consumed. Money, Time, Prayer, and Love are all seeds you can sow into the Kingdom.

It is God’s pleasure to both give you seed and bread. Both may come in the same bud, yes. Be careful to see seed as seed. You can only plant seed. Do not eat your seed and them go and plant your bread. The earth will not reject the bread you plant but it won’t grow it as seed as the earth is only endowed to grow seeds and not bread. A bucket of corn seed can – produce a basin of akamu; can produce a kilogram of flour; can plant an acre of farm land. So decide what to do with your bucket of corn seed.

Time: Time is one of the greatest seed God can give you. [Ecclesiastes 3:1]. Plant it [1 Chronicles 12:32]. Educate yourself [1 Kings 7:13-14]. 

Study the word of God [2 Timothy 2:15]. Seek to know the ways of God [Jeremiah 9:24 –“ But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.” Use your time to follow God [John 8:12 – “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.” 

Money:  Money answers to all things. Waste it, you waste life. Yes. A child of God must know that the essence of having money and good money for that matter is to simply sponsor the work of God. Your gold, land, job proceeds, investment returns, family members, etc. are all primarily seeds to be sowed into the fertile vineyard of God’s Kingdom. Know this you live; reject this, you die, the death of Adam who died but was still walking about. “A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.” Ecclesiastes 10:9.

Prayer: Prayer is another seed you sew and may not see it growing as you watch and pray. Prayer works. Prayer moved mountains. Prayer kills. Prayer saves. Prayer travels. Prayer produces wonders. Prayer is God’s system of mobile communication. It can be made anywhere, at any time, for any purpose. It is a weapon of mass destruction [Matthew 26:53 – “Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?”. It is a weapon of mass salvation [Luke 23:34]. 

Love: Love is a seed that feeds your enemy dead. Proverbs 25:21 – “If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.” Love is a deadly weapon as well as a potent medicine. Love (Charity) is greater than faith. And without faith you cannot please God; yet love is greater than faith. 1 Corinthians 13:13. Love is of God. Only children of God can practice love, true love. He that loves id born of God. Read 1 John 4:7-8. [Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.]

THE BREAD
Yes, bread is good. Bread feeds you today. Bread gives instant satisfaction. It is God that also gives bread to the eater. Isaiah 55:10.

Become a Seed General today.

Supporting Scripture

Luke 6:38 - [Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.]

Psalms 50:5 – [Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”]

Study Questions
What does it mean to sow your bread?
How do we tell bread from seed? [Vision]",

      "content": "SUNDAY SCHOOL LESSON OF TLCGMI 

WEEK 47 – WEEK 48

Eat your bread; sow your seed. You do not sow your bread; and you do not eat your seed. Doing so is doable but is a dangerous mismatch. 

The Isaiah verse in the study text opens our eyes to see that the earth produces seed and bread. The farmer [sewer] picks the seed and plants it, while the consumer [eater] picks the bread and eats it.

THE POWER OF SEED
Seeds have productive mandate. A seed is endowed to produce multiple other seeds endlessly. All seeds die to produce new life. 

THE BELIEVER’S SEED
Do not eat your seed. Do not waste your seed. There is a seed in your hand. See it as seed and not bread to be consumed. Money, Time, Prayer, and Love are all seeds you can sow into the Kingdom.

It is God’s pleasure to both give you seed and bread. Both may come in the same bud, yes. Be careful to see seed as seed. You can only plant seed. Do not eat your seed and them go and plant your bread. The earth will not reject the bread you plant but it won’t grow it as seed as the earth is only endowed to grow seeds and not bread. A bucket of corn seed can – produce a basin of akamu; can produce a kilogram of flour; can plant an acre of farm land. So decide what to do with your bucket of corn seed.

Time: Time is one of the greatest seed God can give you. [Ecclesiastes 3:1]. Plant it [1 Chronicles 12:32]. Educate yourself [1 Kings 7:13-14]. 

Study the word of God [2 Timothy 2:15]. Seek to know the ways of God [Jeremiah 9:24 –“ But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.” Use your time to follow God [John 8:12 – “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.” 

Money:  Money answers to all things. Waste it, you waste life. Yes. A child of God must know that the essence of having money and good money for that matter is to simply sponsor the work of God. Your gold, land, job proceeds, investment returns, family members, etc. are all primarily seeds to be sowed into the fertile vineyard of God’s Kingdom. Know this you live; reject this, you die, the death of Adam who died but was still walking about. “A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.” Ecclesiastes 10:9.

Prayer: Prayer is another seed you sew and may not see it growing as you watch and pray. Prayer works. Prayer moved mountains. Prayer kills. Prayer saves. Prayer travels. Prayer produces wonders. Prayer is God’s system of mobile communication. It can be made anywhere, at any time, for any purpose. It is a weapon of mass destruction [Matthew 26:53 – “Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?”. It is a weapon of mass salvation [Luke 23:34]. 

Love: Love is a seed that feeds your enemy dead. Proverbs 25:21 – “If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.” Love is a deadly weapon as well as a potent medicine. Love (Charity) is greater than faith. And without faith you cannot please God; yet love is greater than faith. 1 Corinthians 13:13. Love is of God. Only children of God can practice love, true love. He that loves id born of God. Read 1 John 4:7-8. [Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.]

THE BREAD
Yes, bread is good. Bread feeds you today. Bread gives instant satisfaction. It is God that also gives bread to the eater. Isaiah 55:10.

Become a Seed General today.

Supporting Scripture

Luke 6:38 - [Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.]

Psalms 50:5 – [Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”]

      "memoryVerse": "2 Corinthians 9:1-10",
      "content": "SUNDAY SCHOOL LESSON OF TLCGMI 

WEEK 47 – WEEK 48

Eat your bread; sow your seed. You do not sow your bread; and you do not eat your seed. Doing so is doable but is a dangerous mismatch. 

The Isaiah verse in the study text opens our eyes to see that the earth produces seed and bread. The farmer [sewer] picks the seed and plants it, while the consumer [eater] picks the bread and eats it.

THE POWER OF SEED
Seeds have productive mandate. A seed is endowed to produce multiple other seeds endlessly. All seeds die to produce new life. 

THE BELIEVER’S SEED
Do not eat your seed. Do not waste your seed. There is a seed in your hand. See it as seed and not bread to be consumed. Money, Time, Prayer, and Love are all seeds you can sow into the Kingdom.

It is God’s pleasure to both give you seed and bread. Both may come in the same bud, yes. Be careful to see seed as seed. You can only plant seed. Do not eat your seed and them go and plant your bread. The earth will not reject the bread you plant but it won’t grow it as seed as the earth is only endowed to grow seeds and not bread. A bucket of corn seed can – produce a basin of akamu; can produce a kilogram of flour; can plant an acre of farm land. So decide what to do with your bucket of corn seed.

Time: Time is one of the greatest seed God can give you. [Ecclesiastes 3:1]. Plant it [1 Chronicles 12:32]. Educate yourself [1 Kings 7:13-14]. 

Study the word of God [2 Timothy 2:15]. Seek to know the ways of God [Jeremiah 9:24 –“ But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.” Use your time to follow God [John 8:12 – “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.” 

Money:  Money answers to all things. Waste it, you waste life. Yes. A child of God must know that the essence of having money and good money for that matter is to simply sponsor the work of God. Your gold, land, job proceeds, investment returns, family members, etc. are all primarily seeds to be sowed into the fertile vineyard of God’s Kingdom. Know this you live; reject this, you die, the death of Adam who died but was still walking about. “A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.” Ecclesiastes 10:9.

Prayer: Prayer is another seed you sew and may not see it growing as you watch and pray. Prayer works. Prayer moved mountains. Prayer kills. Prayer saves. Prayer travels. Prayer produces wonders. Prayer is God’s system of mobile communication. It can be made anywhere, at any time, for any purpose. It is a weapon of mass destruction [Matthew 26:53 – “Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?”. It is a weapon of mass salvation [Luke 23:34]. 

Love: Love is a seed that feeds your enemy dead. Proverbs 25:21 – “If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.” Love is a deadly weapon as well as a potent medicine. Love (Charity) is greater than faith. And without faith you cannot please God; yet love is greater than faith. 1 Corinthians 13:13. Love is of God. Only children of God can practice love, true love. He that loves id born of God. Read 1 John 4:7-8. [Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.]

THE BREAD
Yes, bread is good. Bread feeds you today. Bread gives instant satisfaction. It is God that also gives bread to the eater. Isaiah 55:10.

Become a Seed General today.

Supporting Scripture

Luke 6:38 - [Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.]

Psalms 50:5 – [Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”]

Study Questions
What does it mean to sow your bread?
How do we tell bread from seed? [Vision]",

      "content": "SUNDAY SCHOOL LESSON OF TLCGMI 

WEEK 47 – WEEK 48

Eat your bread; sow your seed. You do not sow your bread; and you do not eat your seed. Doing so is doable but is a dangerous mismatch. 

The Isaiah verse in the study text opens our eyes to see that the earth produces seed and bread. The farmer [sewer] picks the seed and plants it, while the consumer [eater] picks the bread and eats it.

THE POWER OF SEED
Seeds have productive mandate. A seed is endowed to produce multiple other seeds endlessly. All seeds die to produce new life. 

THE BELIEVER’S SEED
Do not eat your seed. Do not waste your seed. There is a seed in your hand. See it as seed and not bread to be consumed. Money, Time, Prayer, and Love are all seeds you can sow into the Kingdom.

It is God’s pleasure to both give you seed and bread. Both may come in the same bud, yes. Be careful to see seed as seed. You can only plant seed. Do not eat your seed and them go and plant your bread. The earth will not reject the bread you plant but it won’t grow it as seed as the earth is only endowed to grow seeds and not bread. A bucket of corn seed can – produce a basin of akamu; can produce a kilogram of flour; can plant an acre of farm land. So decide what to do with your bucket of corn seed.

Time: Time is one of the greatest seed God can give you. [Ecclesiastes 3:1]. Plant it [1 Chronicles 12:32]. Educate yourself [1 Kings 7:13-14]. 

Study the word of God [2 Timothy 2:15]. Seek to know the ways of God [Jeremiah 9:24 –“ But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.” Use your time to follow God [John 8:12 – “Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.” 

Money:  Money answers to all things. Waste it, you waste life. Yes. A child of God must know that the essence of having money and good money for that matter is to simply sponsor the work of God. Your gold, land, job proceeds, investment returns, family members, etc. are all primarily seeds to be sowed into the fertile vineyard of God’s Kingdom. Know this you live; reject this, you die, the death of Adam who died but was still walking about. “A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.” Ecclesiastes 10:9.

Prayer: Prayer is another seed you sew and may not see it growing as you watch and pray. Prayer works. Prayer moved mountains. Prayer kills. Prayer saves. Prayer travels. Prayer produces wonders. Prayer is God’s system of mobile communication. It can be made anywhere, at any time, for any purpose. It is a weapon of mass destruction [Matthew 26:53 – “Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?”. It is a weapon of mass salvation [Luke 23:34]. 

Love: Love is a seed that feeds your enemy dead. Proverbs 25:21 – “If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.” Love is a deadly weapon as well as a potent medicine. Love (Charity) is greater than faith. And without faith you cannot please God; yet love is greater than faith. 1 Corinthians 13:13. Love is of God. Only children of God can practice love, true love. He that loves id born of God. Read 1 John 4:7-8. [Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God. He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.]

THE BREAD
Yes, bread is good. Bread feeds you today. Bread gives instant satisfaction. It is God that also gives bread to the eater. Isaiah 55:10.

Become a Seed General today.

Supporting Scripture

Luke 6:38 - [Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.]

Psalms 50:5 – [Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”]

Study Questions

    "content": "“I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.” Galatians 2:20.

“Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.” Hebrews 4:16.

However, you, as a person of title, an officer in the church or Ministry, should respect the title you carry. That is where the collar of clergy comes in. It is meant to help you check yourself, amongst other purposes, that, you are different, and under watch.

Let your title be a form of a check and barrier preventing you in your subconscious from yielding to the unfruitful works of darkness.

Outward appearance matters a lot in the spirit realm in contrast to what many of us opine. The Bible you carry about physically has a way of stopping the enemy from coming close to harass you.

That physical Bible you carry about can earn you protection and respect. Robbers can stop their victims and finding a Bible with them, may be touched by God to do them no harm.

Are you ashamed to tie up a church programme banner on your gate?
